summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching an investor presentation dated May 28, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer; it does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The presentation is a standard corporate update for investors. As the filing contains no special-situation event and is instead a regular business update, it is classified as 'None' under the filing-based special-situations categorization.
